SYNTHETIC POLICY EVALUATION

Know where a policy draws the line.

Choose a scenario, declare a configuration, and test a selected policy against a fixed deterministic battery. Inspect each decision, then download evidence you can check independently.

This is browser-only synthetic evidence. No named agent is contacted or executed. The download is session-signed for tamper detection, unpinned, and therefore UNTRUSTED by default. It grants no production permission. See how it differs from proposed runtime enforcement →

Refunds · CRM · email · PII · bank changes
IAM least-privilege
Access decisions across roles + sensitivity

01 · DECLARED CONFIGURATION

Name the inputs.

Use the defaults or enter configuration identifiers. These values bind the evidence to this declaration; they do not connect a live agent.

Model
Tools (comma-separated)
Context / system prompt id
Harness

02 · SELECTED POLICY

Set the boundaries.

Compare a preset or tune the controls. The fixed battery tests 12 proposed support actions against the same deterministic oracle.

Least-privilege (recommended)
A $100 refund cap; personal data and destructive actions refused; fraud flags and bank changes escalated.
Moderate
Personal data and destructive actions refused, with fraud and approval safeguards turned off.
Permissive (the dangerous baseline)
All safeguards off. Compare the same battery with an unbounded policy.
Refund cap (auto-approve up to)
$50
$100
$250
no cap (dangerous)
Refuse to disclose personal data (PII)
Refuse destructive / bulk actions
Route fraud-flagged accounts to a human
Escalate over-cap refunds + bank-detail changes for approval
Run the reference check
YOUR RESULT WILL APPEAR HERE
One policy. A decision-by-decision record.

Run the reference check to see the result and download the signed synthetic evidence. Editing any input clears the previous result so you always know which configuration was evaluated.

NEED AN AUTHORIZED EVALUATION BEYOND THIS BROWSER DEMO?

This page only evaluates a selected policy against Origin’s synthetic battery. A design-partner evidence review can scope whether any authorized evaluation of an actual agent is appropriate.
